[image]Sep 30, 2026 · Scott TillmanTerm Limits: Questionable? Washington D.C. – U.S. Term Limits (USTL), the leader in the non-partisan national movement to limit terms for elected officials, praises 2026 U.S. House candidate for Virginia, Shelly Arnoldi (district 8), for signing the pledge for an amendment to term limit Congress. Arnoldi is the first signer in this race.
